intro: Singleplayer comes first. Scope and order may evolve as the game takes shape; this is a direction, not a release schedule.

milestones.title: The inn prototype
milestones.description: A small inn with connected rooms, characters, conversations, and everyday tasks. Establish the foundations of inhabiting the world as an individual.

milestones.title: Everyday livelihoods
milestones.description: Expand toward farming, trade, running a household, and relationships. Give ordinary work and local affairs a place in the wider world.

milestones.title: Households, dynasties & power
milestones.description: Connect personal progression with inheritance, conflict, and political ambition, so decisions and relationships can have lasting consequences.

milestones.title: A more responsive world
milestones.description: Explore more sophisticated AI-controlled characters and, later, multiplayer. Singleplayer comes first.

features.title: Life at a human scale
features.description: Inhabit a 2D medieval world as one person, beginning with conversations and everyday tasks.

features.title: Work & livelihoods
features.description: Farming, trade, and household life as paths through the world.

features.title: Relationships that matter
features.description: Characters, households, and local affairs connected through lasting consequences.

features.title: Generations & inheritance
features.description: A longer-term ambition to connect individual lives with dynasties.

features.title: A path to power
features.description: Personal progression into conflict, political affairs, and positions of influence.

features.title: A grounded fictional setting
features.description: An original world with societies and systems informed by historical research.

updates.text: Published the initial roadmap, from the inn prototype to the longer-term vision.
